shortBio.en: Tool vocalist; also A Perfect Circle and Puscifer.
shortBio.zh: Tool 主唱；另有 A Perfect Circle、Puscifer。

body.en: Born 1964, Ravenna, Ohio. Lead vocals for Tool from the early 1990s. Side projects A Perfect Circle and Puscifer run in parallel eras.
body.zh: 1964 年生于俄亥俄 Ravenna。1990 年代初起任 Tool 主唱。并行有 A Perfect Circle、Puscifer。
